papers.filename: 2024-Rao-NORMAD A Benchmark for Measuring the Cultural Adaptability of Large.md

features.G3_novelty: high

papers.scoring_notes: NORMAD: 2.6K situational descriptions from 75 countries with hierarchical cultural context (ROT / Country+Value / Country). Key finding: LLMs fail to apply cultural knowledge (<60% in abstract settings vs >90% human). English-centric culture advantage. Best LLM <82% vs human >95% even with explicit norms. NAACL 2024. Highly relevant for cross-cultural alignment.
